description: 震度分布 (日向灘地震) [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 宮崎県. 【掲載しているデータはGISデータです】 ・公開データは、検討時点における調査研究成果や知見を踏まえて作成されたもので、今後の調査研究の進展により逐次見直されるべきものです。 ・地震動データは、地震動の影響を評価するために、工学的基盤（Vs=350～700m/s 相当層）において約 1km×1km のメッシュ単位、地表において約 50m×... Coverage: 宮崎県. The portal files it under the publisher 宮崎県. Its tags are 日向灘地震, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2024-03-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
